_comment: Hand-labelled reference pass over one real digest run, used by
scripts/eval-models.mjs to score how closely each local model agrees with
a human. This is the example; copy it to config/reference-labels.json and
replace the entries with your own judgement of your own inbox.
The real file is gitignored, because the descriptions below say a lot about
whose inbox it is - which banks, which brokerages, which alerts.
'execution' must match the n8n execution id you are scoring against, or
eval-models.mjs skips the agree column rather than compare the wrong run.
'labels' is keyed by 1-based position within that run: [LABEL, why].
One lesson worth keeping from the real pass: the first attempt marked every
recruiter email ACTION, on the theory that a human writing directly deserves
a reply. That was an assumption about the user, not a fact about the mail.
Stated context belongs in config/preferences.json, where it is enforced,
rather than left for a model - or a labeller - to guess.
Edit freely. The evaluation is only as good as this file.
